IBBA Segev Play-by-Play

Source: R/ibba_segev.R
ibba_segev_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of a finished game: every action with shot coordinates, running scores and jersey numbers.

Endpoint: GET https://stats.segevstats.com/realtimestat_heb/api/?method=getActions

Usage

ibba_segev_pbp(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

(integer required): Segev game id (e.g. 50 = Hapoel Be'er Sheva vs Maccabi Tel Aviv, 2025-26 round 1): segev_game_id in ibba_games.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerSegev game id (key space: one flat sequence across seasons and competitions); equals the IBBA ibba_games segev_game_id from 2025-26. Not an IBBA game id.
action_idintegerAction id (key space: Segev actions; unique and increasing within one game, 500001 ... for game 50).
parent_action_idintegerId of the action this one follows from (rebound -> missed shot, steal -> turnover, assist or block -> shot); null when none.
periodintegerPeriod number (1-4 regulation, 5+ overtime).
clockcharacterGame clock remaining in the period as 'mm:ss', counting down from 10:00.
user_time_utccharacterWall-clock time the scorer logged the action, 'HH:MM:SS', UTC (inferred: game 50 tipped at 18:40 Israel time and its first tick reads 15:42).
typecharacterAction type: game, quarter, clock, substitution, shot, freeThrow, rebound, assist, steal, turnover, block, deflection, foul, foul-drawn or timeout.
subtypecharacterSubtype by type: shot jump-shot / lay-up / dunk; rebound offensive / defensive; turnover bad-pass, ball-handling, travelling, ...; foul personal / technical / unsportsmanlike; start-of-game, end-of-quarter, ...
team_idintegerSegev team id of the acting side (stable across seasons); null on game-level actions.
player_idintegerSegev player id (key space: Segev players, stable across seasons: Jaylen Hoard = 1000 in games 50 and 419); null on team lines and on actions without a player. Not an IBBA player-season id.
team_sidecharacterSide of the game: home or away (the feed's homeTeam / awayTeam; an action's parameters.team 1 = home, 2 = away).
jerseycharacterJersey number (a string, not an id) of the acting player; null when none (team rebound, timeout).
score_awayintegerAway running score after a scoring action (the feed's score reads away-home); null otherwise.
score_homeintegerHome running score after a scoring action; null otherwise.
player_pointsintegerThe scorer's running points after a scoring action; null otherwise.
pointsintegerShot value, 2 or 3; null on other actions.
madecharacterShot or free-throw result: made, missed, or blocked (shots only).
xdoubleShot x: across the half court, sideline to sideline, 0-1470, basket near 735; which sideline is 0 and the metric scale are unverified.
ydoubleShot y: distance out from the baseline, rim near 112-140, deepest observed 1176; metric scale unverified.
fast_breaklogicalTrue when the shot or free throw came on a fast break.
second_chancelogicalTrue when the attempt followed an offensive rebound.
points_from_turnoverlogicalTrue when the attempt came off an opponent turnover.
free_throw_numberintegerWhich free throw of the set (1, 2, 3).
free_throws_awardedintegerFree throws in the set.
foul_kindcharacterFoul kind, shooting or offensive; absent on some fouls. 'shooting' also appears on technical and offensive-unsportsmanlike fouls, so it does not prove a shooting foul.
fouled_on_jerseycharacterJersey number (string) of the fouled player.
foul_free_throwsintegerFree throws the foul awards (the feed sends a string when non-zero, 0 otherwise).
is_coach_foullogicalTrue on a foul charged to the coach or bench (player_id null); null otherwise.
player_in_jerseycharacterSubstitution: jersey of the player coming in; null on the row that records the player going out.
player_out_jerseycharacterSubstitution: jersey of the player going out; null on the row that records the player coming in.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in ibba_segev_game_info().

See also

Other IBBA Segev Functions: ibba_segev_game_info(), ibba_segev_period_scores(), ibba_segev_player_box(), ibba_segev_rosters(), ibba_segev_team_box()
